Hatosi.l: Hatosi bhattena suvāditena, lolo ca macche anubandhamāno
Hatosi.g: tvaṁ bherivāditasaññāya bhatte dīyamāne lolo hutvā khādanatthāya macche anubandhamāno tena savāditena2 bhattena hato, gataṭṭhānepi te jīvitaṁ natthīti attho.
